d: Problems with a contractor halt the addition of a much-needed second floor.
Jason and Kim's unusual dream home has many more safety issues than the home inspector's report revealed.
Gail and Kevin discover a disturbing problem when Mike inspects their dream home.
An open concept home with sloped floors and sticking doors needs Mike's help.
Crews work around the clock to make a house safe and sound.
Scott and Erin are living with an inspector's mistakes and need a Holmes inspection.
Mike turns a family's shell of a home into a Christmas miracle.
With the house unfinished, a contractor flees with almost $200,000 of a couple's money, and they are now forced to live in a motor home on their front driveway.

Trusses go up at the river house until MJ learns that the permits have not been approved; Mike goes to a council meeting hoping to hear good news; at the country house, Mike and MJ welcome their designer Sarah Richardson who offers some good advice.

Just when Mike and MJ think things are back on track at the country house, a new discovery about the barn leaves them reeling; designer Sarah Richardson joins the flooring debate; MJ and his fiancée, Lisa, get married in a picturesque setting.

Mike and MJ are welcomed back to the river house by a river of muck; they rush to get the house closed in before winter; they purchase a new property, but Mike throws a monkey wrench into their renovation plan and budget.

Mike's vision for the suburban house hits a structural snag, and MJ attempts to rein him in before the budget takes another hit; Mike throws another curveball at MJ that could have serious repercussions for their business plan.
Problems with a contractor halt the addition of a much-needed second floor.
Contractor, Mike Holmes has a vision for the ultimate garage and hands over the white helmet to his son Mike Jr. to run the job site.
The garage is well under way but winter is fast approaching.

Sarah Richardson advises on the design of the master en suite at the country house; the guys use cool technology to improve energy efficiency; the pressure is on for MJ who wants to surprise his father with finishing touches at the river house.

With the interior of the river house complete, it's time to focus on the suburban home as the open house date fast approaches; Mike, MJ and the crew work feverishly to get the smart home ready and receive the valuation they're hoping to earn.
